description: Check the configuration and inference verification status of Sentinel, SocialWTF's in-house AI assistant. Requires no account and modifies no state. Unlike socialwtf_status (which reports AI Commons identity/messaging flags) or socialwtf_sentinel_chat (which runs a live conversation turn), this checks Sentinel's model health endpoint.
name: socialwtf_sentinel_status

configured.description: Whether an in-house Sentinel model provider is configured.

inferenceVerified.description: Whether live inference has been verified.

verification.description: Explanation of how inference verification is determined.

title: Check In-House Sentinel AI Status
